---
name: Research proposal
about: Propose an experiment against the project hypothesis
labels: research
---

## Question

What do you want to find out, stated so that a measurement can answer it?

## Baseline

Which existing workload(s) and which commit serve as the baseline?

## Candidate

What changes? Which module boundary (Docs/future-modules.md) does it belong to?

## Correctness criteria

Which existing checks must still pass (state hash equality, oracle match, chunk-size consistency)?
Which new checks are needed?

## Measurement plan

Hardware, presets, iterations, metrics that decide the outcome, and what result would falsify the idea.
